in_marathi.name: Gurjeet
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gurjeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from Sanskrit words ‘guru’ (teacher) and ‘jit’ (victory). It symbolizes the triumph of knowledge and wisdom over ignorance and darkness. The name carries the blessings of a revered guru and bestows courage, strength, and enlightenment.
